keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 1, Lincoln City 0. Joe Rankin-Costello (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner following a corner.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 2, Lincoln City 0. Ivan Mesík (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner.
Ryley Towler (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Reeco Hackett replaces Ryley Towler.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Bayliss replaces Ivan Varfolomeev.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Freddie Draper replaces Mikkel Ladefoged.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 3, Lincoln City 0. Tyreece Campbell (Charlton Athletic) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Dom Jefferies replaces Ben House.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Miles Leaburn replaces Matty Godden.
Delay in match because of an injury Joe Rankin-Costello (Charlton Athletic).
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Harvey Knibbs replaces Joe Rankin-Costello because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Callum Elder replaces Tom Hamer.
Miles Leaburn (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card.
Andrei Coubis (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Josh Edwards replaces Karlan Grant.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Millenic Alli replaces Tyreece Campbell.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 4, Lincoln City 0. Miles Leaburn (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Josh Edwards with a cross.
Second Half ends, Charlton Athletic 4, Lincoln City 0.
